integrity: Exact polynomial identity and sign certificates are supplied in a standalone reproducibility script. Earlier eight-state minimality for all Markov generators is explicitly credited to prior work; this claim is only the exact doubly stochastic irreducible cycle window.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the completed two-stage fourth-order Gauss--Legendre step on an eight-state uniform directed cycle; not a universal criterion for directed generators, other methods, or internal stages.
title: Exact stochasticity reentry for fourth-order Gauss stepping on the directed eight-cycle
